title: Bo came dressed as the turkey
topic: Thanksgiving 2026 greeting: Bo wears the turkey suit so nobody eats him, won't share the pie because he's shellfish, then the cast waves Happy Thanksgiving. Shows the Harvest Table gear.
hookHeadline: Bo came dressed as the turkey so nobody would eat him.

scenes.speaker: juno
scenes.line: Bo came dressed as the turkey so nobody would eat him.
scenes.description: Two-shot on a warm autumn sea floor: Juno in pilgrim black points at Bo, who struts in a full turkey suit and turkey hat holding a pumpkin pie.

scenes.speaker: bo
scenes.line: Nobody carves the guy in the costume. Basic strategy.
scenes.description: Close on Bo, proud and certain, tail fan spread behind him.

scenes.speaker: juno
scenes.line: Bo, you've been holding that pie for an hour.
scenes.description: Two-shot: Juno in the pilgrim doublet looks across at Bo, who holds the pumpkin pie up.

scenes.speaker: bo
scenes.description: Extreme close-up on Bo, deadpan, snapping on 'shellfish'.

scenes.speaker: juno
scenes.line: Happy Thanksgiving from the whole reef!
scenes.description: Both wave at the camera under a warm 'Happy Thanksgiving' title, autumn leaves drifting down through the water.

caption:
Bo has a plan every year. It is always the turkey suit.

Happy Thanksgiving from all of us.
